aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:860.title: Director, Consumer Product
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:860.description: AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today. We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment. The Role We are looking for a Director, Product Management to lead Conversion, inclusive of ticket selection and checkout for our entire purchase funnel including LA28. In this role, you will define a product strategy for your areas of ownership that is in line with business goals and partner with your team to ensure smooth execution of a prioritized roadmap. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to prioritize features, determine trade-offs, ensure proper resourcing, and align dependencies. You will assess opportunities through stakeholder interaction and data analysis. The ideal candidate is customer-obsessed, data-driven, passionate about delivering best-in-class consumer experiences, and is skilled in leading and developing high-performing teams. What You’ll Be Doing Lead your team in prioritizing, managing and executing on the product roadmap for ticket selection and checkout, ensuring features are prioritized based on business goals, customer insights, and market trends Partner with leadership across engineering, design, product operations, account management, client services, marketing, LA 28, and other stakeholders to validate requirements, develop, test, and launch new features Optimize conversion funnels, personalization, performance, and user engagement to improve fan experiences and business outcomes. Conduct user research and analyze data to drive decision-making and continuous improvement. Communicate product updates, milestones, and priorities to stakeholders and leadership, showcasing product value Defining KPIs for products within portfolio, ensuring alignment with business goals and strategic initiatives Ensure consistency, usability, and compliance with local regulations across all aspects of the website and mobile app Mentor, coach, and support a high-performing team, helping them achieve their potential by creating opportunities for growth Skills and Experience We're Seeking 7-10 years of experience in product management, with a focus on consumer-facing digital products across web and mobile app platforms 5+ years of experience managing a team of product managers Strong understanding of web and mobile product development, and UX best practices. Experience with conversion optimization, personalization, and user engagement strategies. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with significant experience presenting to executive audiences Experience in e-commerce, ticketing, or live entertainment industry is a plus Pay Scale: $170,000 - $260,000 Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position. What’s in it for You? Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding! ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:7.title: Regional Outside Sales Specialist, Educational Services
ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:7.description: This position requires the employee to reside in either North or South Carolina and involves local travel, approximately 80–90% of the time, or 4–5 days per week in the field. Join Aya Healthcare, winner of multiple Top Workplace awards! The Regional Outside Sales Specialist, which is formally titled Regional Client Partnership Specialist, Educational Services, is Aya Education’s field leader and plays a central role in expanding our presence within school districts across the region. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strong district partnerships, assessing full-scope staffing needs, generating job requests, and identifying opportunities for long-term, scalable workforce solutions. Most of your week will be spent onsite in schools and district offices, meeting with SPED Directors, HR leaders, SELPA administrators, Principals, and other key decision-makers. You’ll serve as the face of Aya Education in your region and help ensure districts have access to qualified special education and therapy professionals who support meaningful outcomes for students from early childhood through age 21. Who We Are: We’re a $8+ billion, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform. At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally. Responsibilities: New Business Development: Conduct 5–8 daily walk-ins or 3–4 scheduled meetings with district leaders in order to generate new business Identify, pursue, and secure new business opportunities within assigned markets Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of target districts in order to win new business Generate new job orders across SPED, paraeducator, therapy, behavioral health, and general education support roles Recognize early indicators that may suggest future MSP opportunities Relationship Building and Account Expansion: Develop strong, long-term partnerships with district leadership Visit clients and prospects 4–5 days per week to build familiarity and deepen relationships Conduct onsite assessments to uncover unmet staffing needs and expand existing accounts Serve as Aya’s local market representative and a trusted partner to district teams Collaboration and Cross-Functional Alignment Partner with Account Managers to ensure job orders are filled quickly and accurately Work closely with internal teams, including Recruitment, AM Leadership, Compliance, and Licensing, to support overall account growth Maintain accurate documentation of walk-ins, meetings, and district insights in HubSpot Educate districts on LotusOne, demonstrate platform value, and support onboarding Field Intelligence and Strategic Insights: Track and report on competitive activity, district budget cycles, and hiring trends Identify patterns such as high call-offs, multi-agency usage, inconsistent fill rates, or staffing gaps Use field insights to inform long-term MSP strategy Representation and Events: Represent Aya Education at conferences, regional events, and district engagements Deliver polished presentations and talking points tailored to school leadership Increa

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:6d.title: Diesel Mechanic
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:6d.description: Our client is a premier utility company specializing in rapid response and storm chasing to utility companies and contractors in need of a quick reaction force to repair power outages when they need it most. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide reliable and efficient solutions to help our clients restore power quickly and effectively during emergencies and adverse weather conditions while ensuring operational efficiency and financial sustainability. Our customers are our communities, and when they need us, we are there. We are seeking a skilled and experienced Fleet Mechanic to maintain our fleet maintenance while supporting our rapid response and restoration services. The Fleet Operations Lead Mechanic will play a critical role in the upkept and readiness of our fleet of vehicles, equipment, and assets to ensure optimal performance, safety, and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial vehicle maintenance and maintenance schedules.
responsibilities: Fleet Maintenance:
Regularly review preventative maintenance schedules and ensure all vehicles are being maintained according to schedule
Diagnoses minor mechanical and electronic problems, utilizing diagnostic computer when applicable
Addresses all identified maintenance needs in an efficient manner while ensuring compliance with maintenance reporting requirements
Oversees and leads the emergency response maintenance and repairs as needed
Asset Availability & Utilization:
Ensure repairs are efficiently addressed to maintain asset availability for projects, jobs, and emergency responses.
Analyze asset data to identify opportunities for optimization, including right-sizing the fleet, improving asset utilization, and minimizing downtime.
Assist in developing preventive maintenance schedules and programs to extend the lifespan of fleet assets and reduce maintenance costs.
Equipment Safety and Compliance:
Assist in enforcing safety policies and procedures to ensure the safe operation of fleet vehicles and equipment.
Participate in regular safety training and inspections, addressing any safety concerns or violations promptly.
Assist in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including vehicle inspections, emissions testing, and driver licensing.
Emergency Response Support:
Assist in deploying fleet assets and personnel rapidly in response to emergencies and power outages.
Assist to ensure the readiness and availability of fleet resources during emergency situations.
Oversees and efficiently utilizes emergency mechanical support to ensure any mechanical opportunities are effectively addressed.
qualifications: Certifications in commercial fleet maintenance, as well as a minimum of 5 years proven fleet maintenance experience.
Strong knowledge of vehicle maintenance schedules, hands-on experience in diesel engine and/or heavy vehicle maintenance, diagnosis, repair, and safety compliance.
Excellent communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c9502df0-e8fe-.title: Supervisor, Contact Center (Anesthesia)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c9502df0-e8fe-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Supervisor, Contact Center (Anesthesia) based in United States. This role offers an opportunity to lead a contact center team supporting patients and healthcare providers in a specialized anesthesia environment. You will oversee daily operations while helping create efficient, responsive, and consistently high-quality customer experiences. The position combines people leadership, performance management, escalation handling, and operational improvement. You will coach team members, monitor key performance metrics, and identify opportunities to strengthen service delivery and efficiency. Your healthcare knowledge will help ensure that interactions involving patient information, medical records, and clinical terminology are handled accurately and professionally. You will also contribute to process improvements and special initiatives in a fast-paced, collaborative healthcare services environment. This is an ideal opportunity for a service-oriented supervisor who thrives on problem-solving, team development, and operational excellence. Supervise the day-to-day operations of the contact center, ensuring effective workflows, service quality, and adherence to established standards. Lead, coach, and support contact center employees, including conducting performance evaluations, coordinating work assignments, and making employment or disciplinary recommendations as appropriate. Track, maintain, and monitor employee performance metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring additional support. Resolve escalated patient and customer service issues professionally and efficiently, ensuring appropriate follow-up and resolution. Monitor contact center trends and identify opportunities for process enhancements, innovative solutions, and continuous improvement. Promote a strong customer service culture focused on positive experiences for patients and healthcare providers. Ensure team members follow applicable quality standards, operational procedures, and organizational policies. Support the accurate and appropriate handling of patient health information and medical records. Collaborate with colleagues and other departments to address operational challenges and improve service delivery. Participate in special projects and perform additional responsibilities as assigned. Requirements: High school diploma or GED required; a bachelor’s degree in business, benefits, healthcare administration, or a related field is preferred. Previous experience handling patient health information and/or medical records is preferred, with approximately 5 years of relevant experience considered an advantage. At least 6 months of supervisory or management experience is preferred. Knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy and physiology, and the legal and regulatory considerations surrounding health information. Familiarity with electronic medical record (EMR) systems. Strong supervisory and people-management capabilities, including coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution. Excellent customer service skills with strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication abilities. Proficiency with word processing, spreadsheet, database, and presentation software. Strong time-management, organizational, mathematical, and critical-thinking skills. Ability to handle and resolve escalated calls, correspondence, and customer concerns with professionalism and sound judgment. Ability to understand, analyze, interpret, and clearly explain complex documents and information. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment. Strong attention to quality standards, procedures, and operational guidelines. Ability to understand and apply applicable state and federal laws, regulations, and policies. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:639e86cd-28d.title: Project Epsilon - Dutch Data Trainer
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:639e86cd-28d.description: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented Trainers to support an AI data annotation project. In this role, you will review pre-seeded questions paired with images and provide accurate "golden" answers based on what you observe in the image. This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are meticulous, and able to follow detailed instructions consistently. What You'll Do Review a pre-seeded question along with an accompanying image (e.g., "What is the title of the Excel file based on what you see in the image?")
